source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 23 to 27
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor November 20, 2026 · 8 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler Pushka Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler – November 23Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands. As an expedition engineer, you’ll explore a peaceful Archipelago, configure production flows, refine resources, and achieve perfect efficiency. Build. Optimize. Relax. The Spotter: Dig or Die Forklift Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $12.99 Pre-order The Spotter: Dig or Die – November 23XBOX Play Anywhere You’re a Spotter, the unlucky soul stationed at the worst gas station in Nevada. Your mission: hold the line against mutant hordes spilling from the ruins of Las Veganos, while awaiting a message from the President himself. But when a colossal sandstorm wrecks the base and ruins your only receiver, you lose your one chance of contact. Now everything hinges on repairing it in time. Dig by day, fight by night, and reclaim the signal before the world’s last hope is lost. Descend into a mine to scavenge for resources, discover roguelike artifacts that rewrite the rules, and turn your rusty junkyard into an impenetrable fortress in this unique hybrid of digging simulator and Tower Defense. Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party NexoriumGames ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $11.99 $9.59 Pre-order Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party – November 24 Grab your friends. Lift them over your head. Throw them off a pizza rooftop. Bungle Brawl is a wobbly physics party brawler for 1–4 players on one screen, with bots to fill every match. Everyone is the same jelly body in a different costume. Be a Banana, a Shark, a Hot Dog, a Ghost or a Nightstand. Punch, kick and grab. Knock a fighter dizzy, carry them to the edge while the crowd chants, and let go. Storage Hunter Simulator astragon Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Storage Hunter Simulator – November 24 Master the art of auctions and score big against others for treasures in Storage Hunter Simulator! Stay ahead of the competition in the high-risk, high-reward world of storage auctions. Showcase your skills, win intense bidding wars and sell your hard-earned valuables to customers. Getting the best deal and maximizing your earnings is key to staying in business and building a solid reputation. Cat Mirror Tribus Games Indie ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Cat Mirror – November 25 A deceptively simple puzzle game where symmetry is your greatest challenge. Control two cats at the same time, navigating complex levels where every move is mirrored. It seems easy… until your mind is put to the test. Can you master the reflection? Sokobear Goo Little Giant Game Studio ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Sokobear Goo – November 25 The forest has been invaded by slime creatures, and now it’s up to Bear to help the villagers reclaim their home! Get ready for an adventure filled with puzzles, sticky monsters, and slime explosions. Explore 40 puzzle levels where every move matters. Push slime balls through the environment, plan your moves carefully, and find the right way to eliminate all the Slime Monsters. Bogos Binted GameDev.ist ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Bogos Binted – November 26 Welcome to a sinful night with the galaxy’s craziest aliens! Not every alien visits Earth to witness the indomitable human spirit. Some just want to chill on the Moon’s surface and play games. Born from the legendary internet meme, this isn’t just your average “friendslop” party game. Alien humor is… how should we put it… a bit of a brainrot. In this first-person, four-player, online multiplayer space adventure, every alien at the table must do whatever it takes to win in a variety of tabletop games. You’ll craft sneaky strategies, tell outrageous lies, pull hidden weapons, and literally blow up the heads of your so-called “friends.” Calculus of Rot Brainium Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Calculus of Rot – November 26Smart Delivery The world is dead. Mutants roam the ruins, and every step forward could be your last. Explore dark, infected zones hidden beneath the fog of war. Reveal new paths, discover useful items, and carefully decide which enemies to confront. Every encounter costs resources, and every mistake brings you closer to death. Study enemy strength, plan your route, and use your limited health and attacks wisely. Some monsters are worth the risk. Others should be avoided at all costs. As you progress, stronger abominations begin to appear, turning each map into a deadly tactical puzzle where survival depends on smart decisions rather than luck. Full Metal Sergeant 2 PolyCrunch Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Full Metal Sergeant 2 – November 26Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere If you die on the battlefield, it’s not my fault. You think boot camp’s hard? Try surviving my camp. In Full Metal Sergeant 2 you’re a hellish instructor. Your mission is to transform raw recruits into specialized war machines. Mold their minds and bodies, instill discipline, and hone their combat skills. Gravity SWlTCH Brainium Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Gravity SWITCH – November 26Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks! Step into a high-stakes sliding maze where stopping isn’t an option. In this fast-paced arcade puzzler, once you push in a direction, you slide until a wall stops you. source.title: Introducing Hounded: Crafting the dog adventure coming to PS5 in 2027
source.evidenceText: November 17, 2026November 17, 2026 Introducing Hounded: Crafting the dog adventure coming to PS5 in 2027 13 0 98 Like this Imprnt Studios founders share insights on how to craft the perfect dog protagonist. Julia Galus Marketing Specialist, Silver Lining Interactive Hey PlayStation community! We’ve been keeping a secret under wraps at Imprnt Studios and Silver Lining Interactive, and we can finally let the dog out of the bag: Hounded is heading to PS5 in 2027. Get ready to step into the paws of a brave (and incredibly adorable) Border Collie, Duke, as you help him search for his lost master in an epic journey across the conflict-torn world of Anglodia. Hounded has been in development for just over two years, and in that time we’ve been hard at work developing our very own Motion Matching system for our main character. Along with this exciting announcement, we wanted to show you what making our passion project actually looks like behind the scenes. So, we put together our very first dev diary with a full look into how the sausage (or kibble?) gets made. Have you ever wondered how you make a dog communicate through animation? Or what a realistic quadruped animation made from scratch looks like before it lands on your screen? We’re tackling all of that and more, while introducing the little guy who started this entire journey: Duke. Check it out. Play Video A dog story – who is Duke? Duke is a young, clumsy, yet loyal Border Collie. He lives in the world of Anglodia – a flintlock fantasy inspired Britain in the late 18th century. It is a beautiful and mythical land filled with mysterious technology that is coming apart at the seams under tyrannical rule. However, Duke’s interests lie outside of politics and the brewing rebellion against the crown… His master, Artemys Fletcher – a secretive key player in the resistance, has vanished. Duke’s home has been torn apart by the regime and the only thing that matters now is finding his master. Building a border collie from the paws up Here’s the thing about four-legged protagonists: you can’t just reskin a two-legged skeleton and call it a day. In our earliest test builds, Duke moved like a clunky wooden table with paws. It felt terrible—Border Collies have this iconic, low-slung energy that looks like they are about to run at all times. To bring this into reality in Unreal Engine, we decided to animate all of Duke’s movement by hand, using a handcrafted Motion Matching system. Eventually, we were able to set it up so that it pulls from a library of animations based on real-world references, selects the most appropriate animation for the movement, and smooths out the whole process (for the dev team and for the players). What does the dog say? Giving Duke a good expressive range has easily been one of the biggest creative mountains our narrative and animation teams had to climb. While humans rely on words, smirks, and raised eyebrows, Duke has muzzle twitches, ear pivots, and whiskers. We spent a while studying canine expressions and famous animated dogs (shout out to Dug) to make sure Duke could hold his own in cinematic story moments. Every movement, every sad face, and every happy snout you will see in the game is handcrafted by our incredible animation team. More than just a good boy – Magic of The Tide As adorable as he looks, Duke is far from an ordinary dog. Beneath the soil of Anglodia hums an ancient, strange magic known as The Tide, and Duke is one of its wielders. He possesses unlockable abilities that no other hound has, such as the Power Bark (smash through obstacles in your way) and Power Howl (electrically charge the mysterious technology you find in the world). He can even pierce the veil to perceive ghostly echoes trapped in time, known as Imprints, reliving moments that unfolded hours before he arrived. What will he discover, and will it help him find Fletcher? Wishlist on PS5 today Seeing our game come to life on PlayStation 5 is a dream come true for the whole team—you can add it to your wishlist on your console today. We’ve still got miles to run before 2027, but we wanted to put Duke on your radar early. Take the dev diary for a walk, tell us what you think of Duke, and give your own pets a solid scratch behind the ears from everyone on the crew today. HoundedImprnt Studios Did you like this?
